simulation_notice: All comments below are fictional examples written for this demo.

items.text: I started the business application but was unsure whether the trading name and registered name should match. I stopped to check our records before continuing.
After upload the screen kept spinning. I could not tell if the file was submitted.
The requested document type was clear to me, but our finance colleague had to find the latest copy before I could upload it.
My document upload showed a confirmation immediately. I could see that the file had been received.
The page said more information was required, but I had missed an email asking for an updated document. I found it later and sent the new file.
Three days later I still cannot see progress or what I need to do next.
I can see that my application is being reviewed, but I cannot tell whether any action is needed from me or when I should check again.
The request for another document explained what was missing. After I uploaded it, I was still unsure where to check the new review status.
I uploaded the verification file and saw a loading indicator for a while. There was no clear receipt, so I wondered if I needed to submit it again.
The application checklist helped me gather the company details before I started. I did not have to go back to find missing information.
Verification passed, but the first-payment setup message suggests I cannot use it.
After the account showed active, I needed a separate explanation of the payment setup steps. The verification result itself was clear.
